ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Paradev uses speech recognition to turn your voice into text.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Paradev needs access to your photo library so you can attach images to chat messages.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Paradev uses the camera so you can attach photos to chat messages.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Paradev uses the microphone so you can dictate chat messages.
